_meta.name: shadow-ai-discoverer curated AI tool database
_meta.note: Entries match on name fragments (case-insensitive) or exact extension IDs. Add your own entries and an approved list to tune for your org.

domains.note: Interactive chat sessions — prompts typed by employees flow to OpenAI.
Programmatic API traffic — likely scripts or tools sending data to OpenAI models.
Developer console usage — someone is building or testing with OpenAI keys.
Claude web app traffic — long-context chats can carry whole documents.
Programmatic Anthropic API traffic from scripts or integrations.
Gemini web traffic — check personal vs Workspace account.
Copilot web traffic — verify tenant coverage.
AI search queries leaving the network.
Model/dataset hub traffic — watch for uploads.
Model API traffic billed per run.
Chat/API traffic to DeepSeek — review data-residency fit.

extensions.name: ChatGPT for Chrome
extensions.note: Any text the user types or highlights can be sent to OpenAI's servers. Customer data, source code, or credentials pasted into prompts leave the corporate boundary with no local log.

extensions.name: Claude / Anthropic assistant
extensions.note: Page content and pasted text can be sent to Anthropic's API. Long-context windows mean entire documents can be exfiltrated in a single prompt.

extensions.name: Google Gemini assistant
extensions.note: Can read and summarize page content via Google's AI services. Check whether the account is a personal or Workspace account — personal accounts bypass corporate data controls.

extensions.name: Microsoft Copilot sidebar
extensions.note: May be the sanctioned M365 Copilot or a third-party lookalike. Verify the publisher — impersonator extensions with this name exist.

extensions.name: Perplexity AI
extensions.note: Queries and browsed pages are sent to Perplexity's servers for answer synthesis. Search history becomes a third-party record of employee research.

extensions.name: Notion AI
extensions.note: Workspace content is processed by Notion's AI sub-processors. If the workspace holds customer or HR data, confirm the AI add-on is covered by your DPA.

extensions.name: Grammarly AI writing
extensions.note: Sends keystrokes from every text field — email, docs, tickets — to Grammarly's cloud. Treat as a keystroke-level data flow, not just a spellchecker.

extensions.name: Otter.ai meeting recorder
extensions.note: Joins or records meetings and ships audio plus transcripts to Otter's cloud. Participants are rarely aware; check consent and data-residency requirements.

extensions.name: Fireflies meeting recorder
extensions.note: Same exposure as other AI notetakers: full meeting audio leaves the org. Verify retention and deletion policies before approving.

extensions.name: Jasper AI writer
extensions.note: Marketing copy drafted in Jasper may embed product or customer details into a third-party model pipeline. Check whether brand assets are covered.

extensions.name: DeepL translator
extensions.note: Translated documents are processed on DeepL's servers. Free-tier translations are not covered by the same data-processing terms as DeepL Pro.

extensions.name: QuillBot paraphraser
extensions.note: Rewrites pasted text on third-party servers. Low individual risk, but volume of pasted internal text adds up.

extensions.name: Tome / Gamma AI decks
extensions.note: Slide content and prompts are stored by the vendor. Check sharing defaults — generated decks are often public-by-link.

extensions.name: AI code autocomplete
extensions.note: Source code is sent to the vendor for completion. Proprietary code in prompts or completions can leak IP; verify the vendor's zero-retention option.

services.name: OpenAI / ChatGPT
services.note: OAuth grants with broad scopes let ChatGPT pull data on its own schedule. Confirm scopes are minimal and the account is a business account under your DPA.

services.name: Anthropic Claude
services.note: Claude integrations with Drive, Gmail, or Slack scopes can read large volumes of corporate data. Review scopes and admin controls.

services.name: Google Gemini
services.note: Often bundled with Workspace, which can mask personal-account usage. Distinguish sanctioned Workspace Gemini from personal-account grants.

services.name: Microsoft Copilot
services.note: Verify this is the M365 Copilot covered by your tenant, not a third-party app borrowing the name.

services.name: Perplexity
services.note: Internal research questions become vendor-side query logs. Treat as a data flow for competitive or sensitive topics.

services.name: Notion AI
services.note: AI features process full workspace pages via sub-processors. Confirm coverage in your Notion DPA before sanctioning.

services.name: Midjourney
services.note: Prompts and generated images may be public by default. Brand and product imagery generated here needs an IP review.

services.name: Runway
services.note: Uploaded footage is processed in the cloud. Check retention of source uploads, not just outputs.

services.name: ElevenLabs
services.note: Voice cloning from a short sample is a social-engineering risk. Restrict who may create custom voices.

services.name: Hugging Face
services.note: Uploading datasets or fine-tuning on company data publishes artifacts to a third party. Audit Spaces and dataset uploads.

services.name: Replicate
services.note: Pay-per-run model hosting encourages ad-hoc use with personal API keys. Centralize keys so usage is visible.

services.name: Groq
services.note: Fast inference APIs attract shadow prototyping. API keys in personal accounts are invisible to IT.

services.name: DeepSeek
services.note: Data is processed under the vendor's jurisdiction. Evaluate data-residency and compliance fit before any approval.

services.name: xAI Grok
services.note: Often authorized via X/Twitter OAuth, which can bundle broad profile scopes. Check exactly which scopes were granted.
